aniline.name: Aniline (benzenamine)
aniline.caption: –NH₂ bonded straight to an sp² ring carbon, so the lone pair is shared with the ring's π system.

benzylamine.name: Benzylamine (phenylmethanamine)
benzylamine.caption: One CH₂ between ring and nitrogen — the lone pair stays out of the ring and the base is aliphatic in strength.

tribromoaniline.name: 2,4,6-Tribromoaniline
tribromoaniline.caption: Both ortho sites and the para site carry bromine; the two meta positions are left bare.

p_hydroxyazobenzene.name: p-Hydroxyazobenzene
p_hydroxyazobenzene.caption: Two rings bridged by –N=N–, so conjugation runs unbroken from the –OH to the far ring — the azo dye chromophore.
